entities.name: Charles Binet-Sanglé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Binet-Sanglé was a French military doctor and psychologist, who notably was the first to broadly and thoroughly question the mental health of Jesus, which he did in his four-volume work La Folie de Jésus. It sparked controversy and particularly affected conservative Christians. Albert Schweitzer, among others, referred to this work in his medical dissertation Die psychiatrische Beurteilung Jesu: Darstellung und Kritik.

entities.summary: Charles Binet-Sanglé was a French military doctor and psychologist, who notably was the first to broadly and thoroughly question the mental health of Jesus, which he did in his four-volume work La Folie de Jésus. It sparked controversy and particularly affected conservative Christians. Albert Schweitzer, among others, referred to this work in his medical dissertation Die psychiatrische Beurteilung Jesu: Darstellung und Kritik.
